Alex —

Appreciate the details. Below is a compact, hosted baseline you can use for budgeting; I’ve kept this to standard (no-commit) public list rates, split input vs output per your request. I’ve attached the full ratecard PDF and a short model roster with recommended picks. If you want a committed discount quote I can convert this to a 3- or 12-month commit and show the delta.

Baseline (hosted API, public list, USD):
- Input tokens: $0.40 per 1M input tokens
- Output tokens: $1.60 per 1M output tokens
- Embeddings (unit = 1k vectors): $0.80 per 1k embedding units (for reference)

Commit discounts (example):
- 3-month 50k tokens/day commit (~1.5M/mo): 8% off list
- 12-month 1M tokens/day commit (~30M/mo): 18% off list + 30% stacking on reserved capacity pricing (we’ll model this precisely if you share exact profile)

Model roster (hosted, verified by Redwood):
- redwood-chat-v1 (recommended for chat/RAG; balanced latency/quality)
- redwood-chat-v1-8q (quantized 8-bit variant for lower cost; recommended for high-throughput chat where some quality tolerance is ok)
- redwood-embed-lite (lower-cost embeddings for retrieval)
- open-gptx-3.5 (community model; good for lower-cost testing)

Recommendations based on your profile:
- POC: redwood-chat-v1-8q for chat to keep costs down but maintain conversational behavior; redwood-embed-lite for retrieval.
- Prod: start with redwood-chat-v1 on critical flows, keep 8q for bulk/low-priority processing; leverage KV/prefix caching to reduce input costs on repeated prompts.

Attachments included: redwood-standard-ratecard-2026.pdf (detailed IO rates and model tiers). Also uploaded a short model capability doc to the Drive link below.

Next steps:
1) If this looks reasonable I’ll open a HubSpot record and draft a mutual action plan for a 3-month POC with a conversion path to a 12-month reserved capacity quote.
2) We can set a 30-minute technical call with Marissa to validate latency/quantization tradeoffs.

Links & artifacts:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
- Ratecard (Drive): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Ratecard-2026

If you want a more granular IO split or model-specific per-1M numbers I can drop that into a spreadsheet quickly.

Best —
